# rustinion_retention_policy (Resource)

Manages this tenant's data retention policy: how long each storage tier is kept before the retention sweep prunes it. A tenant singleton — there is exactly one, and it always exists, so omitting an attribute clears that tier back to the platform-wide default rather than leaving it unchanged. Rollups are written incrementally as samples arrive, so shortening a raw tier never costs you the coarser ones.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_metric_hourly_retention_days` (Number) How many days of the hourly custom-metric rollup to keep for this tenant, 1-3650. Omit to use the platform-wide default for this tier.
- `custom_metric_minutely_retention_days` (Number) How many days of the minutely custom-metric rollup to keep for this tenant, 1-3650. Omit to use the platform-wide default for this tier.
- `custom_metric_raw_retention_days` (Number) How many days of raw custom-metric samples to keep for this tenant, 1-3650. Omit to use the platform-wide default for this tier.
- `device_log_retention_days` (Number) How many days of log lines to keep for this tenant, 1-3650. Omit to use the platform-wide default for this tier.
- `device_metrics_hourly_retention_days` (Number) How many days of the hourly host-metric rollup to keep for this tenant, 1-3650. Omit to use the platform-wide default for this tier.
- `device_metrics_raw_retention_days` (Number) How many days of raw host-metric samples to keep for this tenant, 1-3650. Omit to use the platform-wide default for this tier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "retention-policy" — the API addresses this singleton with no id.
